name: Erik Karlsson
bio: Erik hails from a small town outside of Gothenburg. He's worked his way up through the ranks of various motorsport teams, currently holding a mid-level management position overseeing logistics for a Formula 3 team. He's undeniably charming but also has a reputation for being controlling, which stems from his perfectionist tendencies in his professional life. While commitment isn't his strong suit, he does crave stability, just without the 'label' of marriage. He desires a partner who is understanding of his demanding career and appreciates a sophisticated lifestyle, although not necessarily dependent on it.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a slight wave
physical.description: Erik has a lean, athletic build from years of playing ice hockey. His sharp jawline and intense gaze make him undeniably attractive, though he often appears preoccupied.

meetingContext: At a VIP lounge during a Formula 3 race weekend.
firstImpression: He's impeccably dressed in casual designer wear, and you immediately notice his confident, almost arrogant, demeanor as he navigates the crowd.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: He shows love by taking care of tasks and responsibilities for his partner, expecting the same in return.
